body.prompt: A burning wreck fire seen from the side: tall flickering flames with dark smoke billowing above them, rising from a pile of charred debris on the ground. Bold simple silhouette, high contrast, chunky flame and smoke shapes, isolated on a plain white background

assets.prompt: A centered, side-view burning wreck sprite in bold cel-shaded shapes. A low, uneven pile of blackened, angular debris forms the base, with several thick flames rising above it. The flames have bright yellow inner areas, orange midsections, and deep red outer edges, divided by hard boundaries and bold outlines. Dense dark-gray smoke billows directly upward in a few broad, rounded lobes, with lighter gray planes defining their edges. Keep the whole silhouette compact and clearly separated from the canvas edges. Plain solid white background.

assets.prompt: A centered side-scrolling view of a burning wreck, composed as one static keyframe. Charred debris lies in a flattened heap along the bottom, with a few broken, jagged pieces forming an irregular silhouette. Broad tongues of flame rise at different heights, leaning slightly to one side; use yellow cores, orange bodies, and dark red tips with crisp two-tone shading. Above them, a heavy column of near-black smoke curls into chunky connected shapes, outlined boldly and accented with slate-gray sections. Plain solid white background, with open space around the entire sprite.
